description: The capture ledger's record for one planning application, as the LPA published it: the stable 13-key canonical projection plus `surfaces` — every field-value pair the register surface stated, keyed by the portal's own labels and grouped per surface/tab, with repeated records (documents, constraints, dates) as arrays. The `surfaces` key set is per-LPA by design (source-shaped, METADATA_TOTALITY.md): different authorities publish different fields, and this operation returns whatever the authority stated, verbatim, without renaming or narrowing. `surfaces` is null for applications captured before source-totality shipped (2026-07-30 — the archive is write-once and totality is forward-only) and {} where the surfaces were read but the portal published nothing. Look up by LPA slug + the authority's own application number; 404 when the ledger holds no such capture. Person names and contact details (applicant, agent, case officer; their addresses, phones and emails) are withheld as "[withheld: personal data]" — the site address is kept.

reference.description: The LPA's own application number, exactly as published (e.g. '26/02032/FUL').
